### What Happens When You Run from God
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-july-29-2020.html
Passage: Jonah 1:3
Points:
- Running away from God's calling triggers a downward spiral with relational, physical, and financial consequences.
- God introduces loving opposition into our lives to turn us away from harmful decisions and back toward His purpose.
- Disobeying the Lord does not happen in a vacuum; it puts innocent bystanders and loved ones in harm's way.
- Attempting to escape an omnipresent God is futile, and trusting His direction is always in our best interest.

### Disobedience and Reluctance
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-9-2024.html
Passage: Jonah 1:3
Points:
- Choosing disobedience always leads a believer downward until God intervenes.
- Running away from the Lord's calling yields deep spiritual and physical exhaustion rather than freedom.
- God is too merciful to leave His wandering servants alone in the misery of their rebellion.
- Divine pursuit demonstrates God's reluctance to abandon His children, showing that His mercy cannot be outrun.
